description: Unofficial Elaina fan-art companion from Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina. Original quiet-travel choreography includes a low broom hover, diary writing with a pressed leaf, a small paper pinwheel and untangling a hat ribbon from the broom. Silver hair, wide witch hat, opaque dark outfit, tights and closed boots are a stylized full-clothing adaptation with simplified trim and compact props. Three articulated running directions and a small jump are original desktop animation, with no official endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
